nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: How do municipal landfills compare to chemical landfills in terms of POPs inventory?
nodes.answer: Municipal landfills are joining chemical landfills as reservoirs of POPs and other PBTs, although they typically have a lower pollution inventory for individual sites.

nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: How can real-time data monitoring help in adjusting strategies for sustainability goals efficiently?
nodes.answer: Real-time data monitoring allows for the adjustment of strategies based on current performance, ensuring that sustainability goals are met efficiently.
